verdict.rationale: This story asks whether PlayCanvas can act as an MCP client, consuming tools from external MCP servers. A browser-based editor with AI features could plausibly do that, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents the opposite role: an official PlayCanvas Editor MCP Server that lets outside AI assistants control the Editor. That server-side capability does not transfer to this client story, and nothing shows PlayCanvas plugging in MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
